headline: Attruby launch drives sharp revenue growth as losses narrow
summary_short: BridgeBio's Q1 2026 revenue rose to $195M, up 66.8% y/y and 26.2% q/q on Attruby's commercial ramp, while net loss narrowed slightly to $164M despite rising launch-related expenses.
summary_long: Revenue rose 66.8% y/y and 26.2% q/q to $195M, driven primarily by a $143.9M increase in Attruby net product revenue, partially offset by the absence of a one-time $75M 2025 milestone. R&D rose to $126.6M (+$15.2M y/y) supporting late-stage programs; SG&A rose to $163.9M (+$57.5M y/y) on Attruby commercialization and pre-commercial launch prep for upcoming candidates. Net loss narrowed slightly to $164M ($167.4M Q1 2025); diluted EPS improved to -$0.84 from -$0.88. The board authorized a new $500M share buyback (approved May 6, 2026). Cash and equivalents were $880M at quarter-end per SEC filings (company reports $940.2M including marketable securities).
